parts.text: An important task takes the same time as a useless one.
One hour on your dream, or one hour cleaning your desk.
The useless task gives you nothing. No pride. No progress.
The important one changes who you are.
That is why Brian Tracy says: time management is really life management.
Every hour, you choose what you do next.
And you are always free to choose.
Most people choose what is easy.
So choose like your life depends on it.
